blocks.html: This documentation provides a reference to the `sdk.admin.shippingProfile` set of methods used to send requests to Medusa's Admin API routes.

This method creates a new shipping profile. It sends a request to the
[Create Shipping Profile](https://docs.medusajs.com/api/admin#shipping-profiles\_postshippingprofiles)
API route.

types.description: The details of the shipping profile to create.

children.name: type
children.description: The type of the shipping profile.

children.name: metadata
children.description: Custom key-value pairs that can be added to the shipping profile.

types.name: query
types.description: Configure the fields and relations to retrieve in the shipping profile.

children.name: fields
children.description:
The fields and relations to retrieve separated by commas.
